items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Yeah, Doc Randall lived with Sharpie too when he was up there.

ctx.x: Mads talks about just throwing this guy, this radio booker named Gerald. You know, he was going to arrange all kinds of deals for him. Something about Broadway and 54th. I forget the story now. You know. I read it last week and I forget it now. Should have read it again this morning, but too much stuff happens. Was Doc Randall up there when you were there?

Yeah, Doc Randall lived with Sharpie too when he was up there. He was living with a suit. He wasn't working with Sharpie, but he was up there. Who was he working with? I don't know what he was doing. He was up in New York.
Clayton Thor, okay. I was gonna ask you some more deals I had written down here about Wingy's band. Where was Joe Marcelo working then in New York? Did he ever work?
